ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 35-40% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) localized at lobe tips and mottling versus 60-65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominating the central and lower regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a large, contiguous low-intensity dark blob. High-intensity pigmentation is concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes. Extensive small-scale high-intensity circular clusters and irregular mottling are distributed throughout the dark central field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression. The angle is sharp, approximately 50-60 degrees, with the vertex clearly defined against the sea background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire visible boundary. Multiple small-amplitude peaks and valleys (~5-10 pixels in depth) create a jagged edge, with significant irregularity at the furthest lateral tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward sweep. The leading edges show a convex curve leading to the tips, while the overall orientation of the lobes is angled upwards from the central peduncle attachment.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular rings (rosettes) are present. Notable clusters are located on the dark field of the right lobe and scattered across the central fluke, appearing as white-on-black pixel disruptions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, near-vertical high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) are detected in the lower central region, cutting through the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of multiple barnacle attachment scars (circular rosettes) and linear trauma marks. The trailing edge displays irregular wear patterns indicative of physical interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense concentration of small white circular spots on the dark region of the right lobe, creating a unique 'starfield' pattern effect.
